split_policy.primary_axis: behavior phase before hot-path workload, acceptance case, report packet, or counter snapshot
split_policy.positive_rule: runtime performance rows can cite canonical behavior only through parser, sema, lowering, IR, runtime, or e2e owners
split_policy.provenance_rule: benchmark summaries, integration summaries, runnable summaries, packet roots, counter snapshots, and tmp package artifacts are provenance-only and never define native behavior support
split_policy.retired_surface_rule: fallback, shim, compatibility, old-mode, unsupported, unresolved dispatch, strict-dispatch, and alternate acceptance path claims are canonical rejection, strict-error, or provenance-only evidence
